howto: Press Play: the dino jogs on the spot until your first jump.
Tap or press Space to jump; tap again in the air for a double jump.
Swipe down or press the Down arrow to duck under low birds.
Run as far as you can: distance is your score.
tips: High birds fly over your head: just keep running.
A feather gives you a shield that takes one hit.
The magnet pulls bones to you and each one counts double while it lasts.
Clear a cactus by a whisker for a +10 close bonus.
Every 500 m earns a medal; the sky turns to night every 400 m.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up to jump, Down to duck. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap to jump, tap again for a double jump, swipe down to duck

difficulty: An adaptive curve: the desert speeds up the further you run, and obstacles come closer together, but never faster than you can react.

cheats.effect: Iron hide: cacti and birds bounce off you
Bone magnet stays on for the whole run
Slow motion: the desert runs at 60% speed

features.one-tap-start: Play, then one tap jumps and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again or Space on the results card goes straight back to the start line
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the distance, top right of the game
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run explains double jump, ducking and pick-ups
features.results: Game Over card with distance, obstacles cleared, bones, medals, lifetime totals and best
